lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 fixed the review-round-2 finding on test/helpers/lane-expectations.json: both lanes' recorded passFloor and measuredVia narratives were stale at branch HEAD (still showing US-006's original 5720/5680 figures) after US-R1-002 added 11 new tests to test/check-skip-ratchet.test.ts without re-measuring. Re-measured both lanes fresh at branch HEAD: host full-PATH `bun test` = 5731 pass / 0 fail (passFloor :5 updated 5720->5731); real Docker `bun scripts/test-in-container.ts` = 5691 pass / 0 fail / 40 skip, exit 0 (passFloor :11 updated 5680->5691, container skip count unchanged since none of the 11 new tests are container-skipped). Both measuredVia strings (:7, :13) rewritten to describe this re-measurement instead of the stale US-006 one. Both new pass counts match exactly what the round-2 reviewer had independently measured and recorded in the finding text, so no further drift investigation is needed. triage.hardDependency=42 and triage.legitimateEnvironmental=1 (lines 17-19) were untouched -- the reviewer had already re-verified those as correct and the finding only asked for the pass-count fields. Quality gates all green post-fix: bun run typecheck 0 errors; bun test 5731 pass / 0 fail / 12933 expect() across 341 files; bun run check:skip-ratchet -> 'host lane: 0 skip (matches recorded expectation)'; bun run check:all all 16 gates green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet). No production code changed -- this was a pure data-freshness fix to a JSON fixture, scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts itself (the US-R1-002 mechanism that reads passFloor) is untouched and correct. Note for the supervisor: scripts/cam/prd.json (not touched by this story, per protocol) already carries a second round-2 finding, US-R2-002, targeting scripts/test-in-container.ts:221 (runInContainerTests never calls the checkSuiteRan positive-evidence guard on the container lane, only checkSkipCount) -- that is a separate, still-unaddressed production-code fix and is presumably the next story to dispatch.
